notes: §1985:VII.4.4.3 SR2: "The AT END phrase must be specified if no applicable USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION procedure is specified for file-name-1." SequentialIoBinder.BindRead calls ExceptionPhraseRequirement.Require (Year < 2002); Written accepts only a non-negated AT END for a sequential file, and HasApplicableUse a USE naming the file or an open mode (own unit or a container's GLOBAL one); the witness is READ IN-FILE with neither. Probes (work-rd-09/io r1-r7): b) refused COBOL6826: no phrase, NOT AT END alone, a USE naming another file, a READ nested in another READ's AT END; accepted: AT END (run: 'EOF2' at end of file), USE ON the file (run: 'R1 00 REC1', 'DECL INF 10', 'R2 10': e) control continues after the failed READ), USE AFTER STANDARD ERROR ON INPUT with READ INTO; c) Require is in force below 2002 only (the START and WRITE arms of the same Require compile clean at 2002 and 2023); a), d), f) do not apply to a statement-level phrase rule. Re-adjudicated 2026-11-12 (held-85/set7, the adjudicator's amendment to kb/Work PB5413 on 1985-SR-VIII.4.3.3-2): CONFORMS -> PARTIAL. A sequential file whose file description entry has a LINAGE clause can never be opened EXTEND (§1985:VII.4.3.3 SR3: 'The EXTEND phrase must only be used for files for which the LINAGE clause has not been specified'), so a USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION PROCEDURE ON EXTEND can never run for it and is not an applicable procedure for its READ; HasApplicableUse counts it (d.ModeIndex is not null). Probe E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/held-85/set7/p/linx.cob (FD SF LINAGE IS 10 LINES, only USE ... ON EXTEND, READ SF with no AT END), rerun on the pinned compiler E:/COBOL-wt/coderead85-tree-c (fafa91a83c) with --std 85 --source-format fixed --run: compiles with no diagnostic and prints 'AFTER 00'; expected COBOL6826. The other arms recorded above (no phrase, NOT AT END alone, a USE naming another file, USE ON the file, a mode USE the file can be open in, GLOBAL) are right. kb/Work PB5413 holds the defect (adjudication: held-85/set7/decisions.json, row 1985-SR-VIII.4.3.3-2).

next.reason: §1985:VII.4.4.3 SR2: 'The AT END phrase must be specified if no applicable USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION procedure is specified for file-name-1' (a compile-time refusal of a sequential READ). 2023 has no READ syntax rule requiring AT END (§2023:14.9.30.3) and states the refused case: §2023:14.9.30.4 GR24 d): 'If the AT END phrase is not specified in the input-output statement, any applicable at end exception processing statements are executed. If there are no applicable at end exception processing statements, control is transferred to the end of the READ statement'. This record's own text names AT END only (the 1985 sequential READ has no INVALID KEY phrase), so 'to' holds the at end rule and neither §2023:9.1.14 rule. Words that differ: 1985 'must be specified'; 2023 'not specified ... there are no applicable ... exception processing statements, control is transferred to the end'. A statement 1985 refuses is accepted by 2023 with a stated run-time effect: a lifted refusal, so CHANGED (kb/Work PB5021), not REMOVED.
